Catch an opening app with the gesture (experimental)
Pixel Launcher jumps an app\'s opening animation to its end the moment you touch the gesture bar. With this on, the animation keeps running and the gesture takes the window where it stands.
Changes take effect at the next animation. After installing or updating the module, restart Pixel Launcher once.
